evidence.title: Trump isn't ‘completely wrong’: Hormuz disruption is Asia’s problem, says Singapore's foreign minister

occurrences.checkable_against: Iranian maritime regulations or toll directives and CNBC interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: From Tehran’s perspective, the ability to charge vessels could effectively establish its right to determine which ships are allowed through, giving Iran what Balakrishnan described as a potential “veto right” over Hormuz.

occurrences.subject: Vivian Balakrishnan's assessment of Strait of Hormuz disruption

occurrences.checkable_against: Singapore Foreign Ministry statements and UNCLOS provisions on transit passage and freedom of navigation
occurrences.quote_span: For Singapore, that principle is “non-negotiable,” Balakrishnan said, citing the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and the rights of transit passage and freedom of navigation.
occurrences.speaker: Vivian Balakrishnan
occurrences.subject: Vivian Balakrishnan's assessment of Strait of Hormuz disruption

occurrences.checkable_against: Singapore government statements and policies on relations with Washington, Beijing and navigation through the Strait of Malacca
occurrences.quote_span: Balakrishnan has maintained that Singapore would “refuse to choose” between Washington and Beijing, instead acting according to its own long-term national interests, while stressing that the city-state would uphold freedom of navigation through the Strait of Malacca and would not participate in efforts to close, interdict or impose tolls on the waterway.
occurrences.speaker: Vivian Balakrishnan

occurrences.checkable_against: CNBC interview transcript or recording with Singapore Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan
occurrences.quote_span:
Singapore foreign minister Vivian Balakrishnan on Hormuz

SINGAPORE — U.S. President Donald Trump isn’t “completely wrong” in suggesting that the disruption to energy flows via the Strait of Hormuz is Asia's problem, Singapore Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan said.

occurrences.subject: Vivian Balakrishnan's assessment of Strait of Hormuz disruption
